verdict.rationale: Clerk can be automated without a UI. It publishes an OpenAPI spec for its Backend API, and its open-source migration tool creates users through that API in bulk. API keys and M2M tokens authenticate programmatic and agent callers, and an official CLI handles app linking, webhook relay, sign-in URLs and production deployment. missing for 10: explicit CI documentation (non-interactive CLI flags, token-based CLI auth from env vars, pipeline examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
